title: A θ-weighted integral of an integrand bounded by c·1_G is at most ofReal(c)·μ_R(G)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U (IMRep U n), let G ⊆ ℝ^P be measurable, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ and c ∈ ℝ satisfy |g(x)| ≤ 1_G(x)·c for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x (Hⁿ = μHE[n]; in Lean |g x| ≤ G.indicator (fun _ => c) x). Then ofReal(∫_M θ(x)g(x) dHⁿ(x)) ≤ ofReal(c)·μ_R(G) in [0, ∞], where μ_R = R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (c : ℝ), MeasurableSet G → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), |g x| ≤ G.indicator (fun _ => c) x) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * g x ∂μHE[n]) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * R.measure G
